name: SG Finserve Ltd
title: SG Finserve Ltd - 539199 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Supply-chain NBFC reports FY26 AUM ₹3,936 cr (+75%) with nil-NPA guidance and 25–30% medium-term AUM growth; no supply-side or utilisation data, and evasive on the ROA/fee-income questions.

triggers.label: FY27 AUM growth 35–40% aspiration
triggers.quote: our AUM growth guidance is 25% to 30%. But if I were to dissect it between FY'27 and years further, I think 35% to 40% is the guidance

triggers.label: Fee income jump ~₹6.2 cr in Q4
triggers.quote: this quarter it is INR6.23 crores. So what is the reason for such a huge big increase?

guidance.quote: Yes, 25% to 30% CAGR remain our guidance for the AUM growth.
our AUM growth guidance is 25% to 30%. But if I were to dissect it between FY'27 and years further, I think 35% to 40% is the guidance
we shall operate with return on asset of 4.5% to 5% kind of a range
return on equity of 14% to 16% kind of a range
our comfortable range is 2x - 3x with aspiration to achieve 3x over the next two to three years
That is why our guidance on NPAs continues to be nil.
Future PAT guidance is on the PAT of previous financial year and not on exit run rate of Q4.
